english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14B(1), 38(1)(b) and 44 of the Health Protection (Coronavirus Restrictions) (No. 5) (Wales) Regulations 2020.

english.notes:
(i) Please note - whilst this is a summary offence, the offence is not governed by the 6 month time limit that would usually apply to offences as set out in section 127(1) of the Magistrates Court Act 1980. This is because the offence is created by regulations made under the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984. Section 64A of the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984 provides the time limits for this offence, being before the end of the period of 6 months beginning with the date on which evidence which the prosecutor thinks is sufficient to justify the proceedings comes to the prosecutor's knowledge; and within 3 years of the date of the commission of the offence.
(ii) In relation to this offence, section 24(5) of the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 is amended; necessity criteria include to maintain public health or to maintain public order.
